verdict.rationale: Jina Reader is a web-fetch and search API for agents, so letting users set agent effort on data-gathering is a fair axis for this kind of product. The evidence shows no low/medium/high reasoning-effort setting. `x-respond-timing` (latency versus completeness) and the `research` preset are adjacent controls, not an effort level for an autonomous agent, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can set how much reasoning effort an autonomous agent spends on a data-gathering task (low, medium, high)
